new: A bronze tablet certifying a soldier's discharge and Roman citizenship, dated 22 November 139, is cited by Masalha as the earliest official use of the name Syria Palaestina. Given to the Louvre in the 1890s, it was said to come from near Nazareth; its first editor thought it was probably found at Daraa in the Hauran.
